newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah steady against dollar after polls.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah steady against dollar after polls.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar on Friday morning, and showed potential for strengthening as more results from the general elections were announced, dealers said.
They said trading was slow, with rates hovering between 2,438.5 and 2,439.5 in the morning.

"The results appear to be within expectations," one Japanese bank dealer said. President Suharto's ruling Golkar party took an unassailable lead with more than half the potential ballots counted on Friday, election figures showed.
The dealers said the results were in line with market expectations, suggesting a possible calming down in the market after jitters earlier on election-related violence during the campaign period.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,438.25/38.75 at 0315 gmt compared with an opening of 2,441.00/43.00.

Overnight money was traded at six percent and overnight swaps were at -0.3/-0.2 points. Longer-term money was also softer. One- and three-month money were traded at 12.5 percent and 13.25 percent respectively.
"I think the rupiah is likely to strengthen further when more election results come in, confirming the current trend," the Japanese bank dealer said.

Another dealer said a rally in the Jakarta stock market on Thursday seemed to have encouraged rupiah investors, however, some remained cautious over possible social unrest in the aftermath of the general election.

Dealers said longer-term swaps were softer due to ample short-term funds. One-month swaps were at 12.0/12.5 points, two at 24.25/24.75 points, three-months at 36.0/37.0 and six-months at 75.0/78.0 points.
